items.name: Sarah Jenkins
items.bio: I build and ship web products end to end: front-end, APIs and the deployment pipeline. Ten years of experience across startups and agencies, and I like projects where I own the outcome rather than a ticket.

reviews.name: Rachel Adams
reviews.text: The most organised developer we have worked with. Daily updates, no surprises, and the launch was completely uneventful, in the best way.

reviews.name: Kevin Doyle
reviews.text: Architected a rewrite that cut our hosting bill by 40%. Reads code like a reviewer and writes it like an owner.

reviews.name: Marta Kowal
reviews.text: Estimates honestly, delivers on the estimate, and flags risks early. Exactly what you want in a senior contractor.

items.name: Michael Chen
items.bio: I help early-stage companies look like they have been around for years. Positioning, identity and the design system that keeps it consistent once the team starts growing.

reviews.name: Felix Grant
reviews.text: Ask the hard positioning questions before opening Figma. That discipline is why our rebrand actually stuck.

reviews.name: Aisha Rahman
reviews.text: A rare mix of strategic thinking and craft. Our deck, site and packaging finally speak the same language.

reviews.name: Tom Fletcher
reviews.text: Superb work at a premium rate. Worth it for a funding round or a rebrand, less so for small one-off jobs.

items.name: Elena Rodriguez
items.bio: I write content that ranks and reads like a human wrote it. Editorial background, agency speed, and a spreadsheet habit when it comes to keyword research.

reviews.name: Georgia Mills
reviews.text: Briefs come back better than they went in. Fourteen months of articles and I have never had to rewrite one.

reviews.name: Daniel Okafor
reviews.text: Organic sessions doubled in a quarter. She cares about the business, not just the word count.

reviews.name: Helen Zhao
reviews.text: Excellent long-form work. Occasionally slower to respond during her busy weeks, but always delivers.

items.name: David Kim
items.bio: Former analytics lead at a marketplace, now helping teams stop arguing about numbers. Dashboards, forecasting and the unglamorous data cleanup that makes both possible.

reviews.name: Victor Huang
reviews.text: Turned three conflicting reports into one number everyone trusts. Calm, precise and fast.

reviews.name: Sara Lindqvist
reviews.text: Set up our dbt models and documented them properly for once. The handover was flawless.

reviews.name: Omar Farouk
reviews.text: Found the retention leak that had been hiding in our funnel for a year. Paid for the engagement many times over.

items.name: James Carter
items.bio: Editor and motion designer for brands that need content weekly. Documentary pacing for long-form, fast hooks for vertical, and a library of transitions that never gets gimmicky.

reviews.name: Mia Kowalski
reviews.text: Delivers a week of content from one shoot. Our posting schedule has never slipped since we started working together.

reviews.name: Chris Bannon
reviews.text: Great instinct for what to cut. Forty-minute episodes now feel like twenty, without losing the good parts.

reviews.name: Nina Costa
reviews.text: Strong creative and clean files. Book him early, his calendar fills up fast.

items.name: Anna Klein
items.bio: Performance marketer who treats ad spend like it is coming out of my own pocket. Full-funnel paid social and search, with creative testing built into every account I run.

reviews.name: Owen Fletcher
reviews.text: Took over an account that was losing money and had it profitable in six weeks. Ruthless about killing bad campaigns.

reviews.name: Julia Rossi
reviews.text: Strong results and clear reporting. Direct communication style is not for everyone, but it works.

reviews.name: Mark Sullivan
reviews.text: The first marketer who sent us a dashboard instead of a pitch deck. Renewed twice already.

items.name: Marcus Lee
items.bio: Cross-platform mobile developer shipping apps to the App Store and Play Store since 2016. Comfortable owning the whole release cycle, including the store submissions nobody enjoys.

reviews.name: Priyanka Nair
reviews.text: Guided our first store submission through review without a single rejection. Steady, experienced and easy to brief.

reviews.name: Eric Lund
reviews.text: Rewrote our flaky build pipeline and the crash rate dropped by 80%. Thorough documentation left behind.

reviews.name: Siti Rahman
reviews.text: Reliable and communicative. Slightly more expensive than alternatives, but the quality justifies it.

items.name: Sabriel Adriel San Agustin
items.bio: Front-end developer turning designs into fast, accessible interfaces. I care about the unglamorous details: loading states, keyboard navigation and responsive layouts that survive real content, not just Figma.

reviews.name: Andrea Lim
reviews.text: Rebuilt our dashboard front-end in six weeks and it is night and day. Clean components, real TypeScript types and zero hand-waving.

reviews.name: Jose Ramirez
reviews.text: Delivers exactly what was scoped, when it was scoped. Rare to find someone this organised at this rate.

reviews.name: Claire Mendoza
reviews.text: Strong React work and great eye for detail. Would love more proactive suggestions on UX, but the output is always solid.

items.name: Aeron Christoper Martinez
items.bio: Web designer crafting fast, responsive sites for brands and creators. From wireframe to launch: layout, typography and the handful of details that turn casual visitors into customers.

reviews.name: Tricia Gomez
reviews.text: Redesigned my creator website in a week and enquiries doubled. Clean layouts and genuinely fast turnaround.

reviews.name: Benjamin Cruz
reviews.text: Understands what makes a small business look credible online. Our new site finally brings customers through the door.

reviews.name: Nathan Santiago
reviews.text: Fast turnaround and clean mockups. Occasionally needs a revision round on spacing, but always lands it.

items.name: Jasmine Reyes
items.bio: Illustrator and social media designer for brands that want a human touch. Custom illustrations, carousel systems and profile kits that hold up in a fast-scrolling feed.

reviews.name: Katrina Aquino
reviews.text: Her illustration style gave our launch campaign a personality we could not have bought from a stock library.

reviews.name: Miguel Tan
reviews.text: Lovely, cohesive social pack. Turnaround was a touch slower than promised, but the quality made up for it.

reviews.name: Diwata Santos
reviews.text: Exactly the warm, hand-drawn look the brand needed. The carousel templates are still in weekly rotation.

items.name: Paolo Villanueva
items.bio: SEO content marketer focused on durable organic growth. Keyword strategy, brief writing and optimised articles that earn rankings instead of renting them.

reviews.name: Ramon Villareal
reviews.text: Organic signups up 48% in one quarter. Every recommendation came with a reason and a number behind it.

reviews.name: Liza Domingo
reviews.text: Audits our content calendar every month and it shows. Priorities are ruthless and always correct.

reviews.name: Ian Beltran
reviews.text: Half the freelancers we hired delivered articles; Paolo delivered a strategy. Renewed for another quarter.

items.name: Camille Soriano
items.bio: Product designer who ships whole flows, not just screens. Research, wireframes and high-fidelity Figma files your engineers can build from without a single Slack escalation.

reviews.name: Andrea Lim
reviews.text: Prototype tested well before a single line of code was written. Her flows have almost no dead ends.

reviews.name: Jose Ramirez
reviews.text: Weekly check-ins, clear decision logs and a handoff our devs loved. Expensive-feeling quality at a fair rate.

reviews.name: Grace Lim
reviews.text: Strong UX instincts and patient testing sessions. Branded visuals were more functional than glamorous.

items.name: Rafael Mendoza
items.bio: Scriptwriter for podcasts, YouTube and branded video. Cold opens that hook, pacing that breathes and scripts that read aloud like they were never written to be read.

reviews.name: Marco Villanueva
reviews.text: Our edit time halved because the scripts breathe on their own. He writes for the ear, not the eye.

reviews.name: Luis Fernandez
reviews.text: Great hooks and tight pacing. Occasionally needs a brief clarified, then delivers clean drafts.

reviews.name: Marites Villanueva
reviews.text: Rescued our founder-led video series from rambling. Watch time is up across every episode.

items.name: Frances Dela Cruz
items.bio: Virtual assistant who runs inboxes, calendars and follow-ups before you notice they were messy. Quiet, documented, and allergic to missed deadlines.

reviews.name: Ian Beltran
reviews.text: Inbox zero every weekday and a calendar that defends my focus time. I genuinely cannot run without her now.

reviews.name: Liza Domingo
reviews.text: Set up our CRM, cleaned six months of duplicates and wrote the SOPs in her first week. Impressive.

reviews.name: Grace Lim
reviews.text: Replies in our voice, flags what matters, documents everything. The safest hire I have made here.

items.name: Gabriel Navarro
items.bio: Cross-platform developer shipping Flutter apps from prototype to store. Solid architecture, sensible state management and builds that survive real devices.

reviews.name: Priyanka Nair
reviews.text: Took our Flutter MVP from Figma to the Play Store in seven weeks. Clean architecture, no shortcuts.

reviews.name: Eric Lund
reviews.text: Solid engineer, honest estimates. Onboarding into our repo took a little longer than planned.

reviews.name: Siti Rahman
reviews.text: Shipped our field-service app and handled the store submission solo. Smooth all the way through.
